title: Magnesium-ion-doped silica nanosheets as degradable drug carriers with enhanced antibacterial activity and cellular uptake
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3183-3191
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07626E, Paper
Open Access

Ruohan Liao, Chengdong Zhang, Zechuang Wang, Xingping Li, Chao Pu, Xuwei Luo, Gang Feng, Qiang Su, Dongqin Xiao
The synthesis of degradable magnesium-ion-doped silica nanosheets (MgMSNs) that exhibit antibacterial activity and cellular uptake capability positions them as promising candidates for drug delivery systems.
